scope: Proposition 4.5 of the manuscript “The joint Dickman law for consecutive integers” (preprints/The-joint-Dickman-law-for-consecutive-integers-September-24-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 012 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 e66b4e8a1fe197d3), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 34. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: There is c5 > 0, independent of all sufficiently large fixed C∗, for which the nonnegative energy below satisfies the displayed lower bound: I2,x = 1 x ∑ c≥1 ρ0(log c/B)A(c) ∑ m≥1 K(m) ∑ a≥1 c|am+1 A(a)K(la)ψ(a/(Tc))ϕ(am/x)Fx(am + 1) 2 , lim inf B→∞ lim inf x→∞ I2,x BT ≥ c5 (4.10) Its diagonal contribution is negligible: lim B→∞ lim sup x→∞ I diag 2,x BT = 0.
